Name: Shipping Bin Recolors
Author: OfInstrumentals
Description:
When I started working on this mod about four years ago there weren't any standalone shipping bin recolors on the Nexus. In the years I've been working on this I got a bit feature creeped, but now I'm finally publishing it. If you notice any issues please let me know and I will try to fix it as soon as I can.

I recommend using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the settings, though a config guide is also included in the mod folder.

This mod will conflict with other mods that change the shipping bins.

I made an Alternative Textures version of this mod, but due to how AT works it is more simplified and has less options. It can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43197]here[/url].

[b][u]Update[/u]
[/b]The color of the grass around the shipping bin should now match the grass of these map recolors: DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour, Starblue Valley Unofficial, and Vibrant Pastoral.
Multiple people had problems with other mods conflicting with my bins, and I might have figured out how to fix that but I'm not 100% sure.

I also added two new color options for the insides of the bins, BluePastel and Pink.


[b]What this mod does[/b]
With this mod you can separately change the color of the body, the lid, the hinges, the insides of the main farm and Ginger Island shipping bins, as well as add flowers around them during spring and summer, or just summer. The body, the hinges and the insides of the craftable shipping bin are also changeable. All of them are also optional, so if you want a vanilla colored bin with just the hinges a different color, that is possible.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oDALKFO.gif[/img]


[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI and Content Patcher

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the file and drop the Shipping Bin Recolors-folder in to the Mods-folder.
This mod will most likely conflict with any other mod that adds anything cosmetic to the shipping bin, though I haven't tested that so I can't be sure.

Manifest.Name: Shipping Bin Recolors
Manifest.Description: Recolors the shipping bins, their hinges and adds flowers
